ns2:section.sectionText: 1hour. Topic: Analysis of Biological Data in R This seminar will focus on developing skills in the use of R. It will cover the book ?The Analysis of Biological Data? by Whitlock and Schluter who created a website with R code to accompany the book. It will also use ?The R Graphics Cookbook?. Students will be assigned weekly problem sets to be performed in R and will share their R-code and show how they solved problems. Weekly quizzes will occur on the assigned reading. This seminar will continue in Spring 2016 to complete the book. Students enrolled in the fall need not enroll in spring. Students must bring their own laptops to class. No prior experience with R is necessary. COURSE WILL MEET IN THE VIVARIUM CONFERENCE ROOM.
